name: protendai/nativephp-lan
description: Local-network file transfer for NativePHP Mobile: UDP multicast + HTTP discovery and an embedded receive server that streams uploads to disk, with PHP deciding who may send.

bridge_functions.name: Lan.StartDiscovery
bridge_functions.description: Announce this device by UDP multicast, listen for others and probe the local /24 over HTTP. Devices arrive as PeerFound.

bridge_functions.name: Lan.SweepSubnet
bridge_functions.description: Probe one /24 (e.g. a Wi-Fi Direct group) in rounds until a device of this service answers. Emits PeerFound.

bridge_functions.name: Lan.Announce
bridge_functions.description: POST this device's info to a receive server (register) until it answers, so it learns our address.

bridge_functions.name: Lan.StopDiscovery
bridge_functions.description: Stop multicast discovery, subnet probes, sweeps and announces.

bridge_functions.name: Lan.StartServer
bridge_functions.description: Start the HTTP receive server (configured port, or port + 1 when busy). Returns the bound port.

bridge_functions.name: Lan.StopServer
bridge_functions.description: Stop the receive server: parked requests get 503, live connections close, partial files are removed.

bridge_functions.name: Lan.Respond
bridge_functions.description: Answer a parked send request (UploadRequested) with any HTTP status; 200 accepts files into a session.

bridge_functions.name: Lan.CancelSession
bridge_functions.description: Cancel a session from the receiving side; uploads stop and partial files are removed.

bridge_functions.name: Lan.LocalIp
bridge_functions.description: The device's current LAN IPv4 address.

bridge_functions.name: Lan.WifiEnabled
bridge_functions.description: Whether the Wi-Fi radio is on (Android; always true on iOS).

bridge_functions.name: Lan.PickFiles
bridge_functions.description: Utility: multi-select document picker. FilesPicking, then FilesPicked with readable copies.

bridge_functions.name: Lan.PickMedia
bridge_functions.description: Utility: multi-select photo/video picker. FilesPicking, then FilesPicked with readable copies.

bridge_functions.name: Lan.Thumbnail
bridge_functions.description: Utility: write a JPEG preview of an image or video file (or Android content:// URI).

bridge_functions.name: Lan.OpenFile
bridge_functions.description: Utility: open a received file in the system viewer (Android intent chooser, iOS Quick Look).

info_plist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: This app looks for nearby devices on your Wi-Fi network to send and receive files.
